question: which nucleotide records are named in our own cross-references but were never downloaded?
why_it_matters: a sequence without genomic context has no operon, no neighbourhood and no replicon, so it is counted in no per-type member total and gets no evidence tier. When the record holding it is known by accession and simply absent, that is a gap in the ingest rather than in the data
how_the_list_is_built: every sequence that passes the gate, carries a type and has no genomic context is looked up through its UniProt EMBL cross-reference; if that nucleotide record is not in the replicon table it enters the list. Each row therefore stands on an identified record holding at least one sequence this database has already accepted and typed
does_not_download: nothing is fetched here. Taking 12,312 records changes every published number and is a data revision, which is a curator's decision
